robots.name: Mission Planning Pipeline
robots.description: Chain
robots.storeType: rocket design → Hohmann transfer → animated orbital insertion. Full mission report.
robots.creator: serge-ivo

robots.name: Exoplanet Transit
robots.description: Detect exoplanets from light curve dips. Adjustable planet size/period/inclination. Habitable zone check. TRAPPIST-1 preset.
robots.creator: serge-ivo

robots.name: Mars EDL
robots.description: 7 minutes of terror — atmospheric entry, parachute, powered descent, sky crane. Entry angle controls failure modes.
robots.creator: serge-ivo

robots.name: Attitude Control
robots.description: 3D wireframe spacecraft with reaction wheels. 6 modes
robots.storeType: manual, rate damping, sun-pointing, detumble. Quaternion dynamics.
robots.creator: serge-ivo

robots.name: Solar System
robots.description: All 8 planets with real Keplerian orbits. Kepler equation solver. Asteroid belt, dwarf planets, Saturn rings. NASA data.
robots.creator: serge-ivo

robots.name: Crater Detector
robots.description: Sobel edge detection + Hough transform finds craters on procedural lunar surfaces. Human vs AI comparison mode.
robots.creator: serge-ivo

robots.name: Star Classifier
robots.description: Neural net classifies stars by temperature/luminosity/radius. HR diagram visualization. Sun, Betelgeuse, Sirius presets.
robots.creator: serge-ivo

robots.name: Hohmann Transfer
robots.description: Calculate interplanetary transfers. Delta-v, travel time, launch windows. Animated spacecraft along transfer ellipse.
robots.creator: serge-ivo

robots.name: Orbit Simulator
robots.description: Launch satellites — altitude, inclination, eccentricity. ISS/GEO/Molniya presets. Kepler orbits with time control.
robots.creator: serge-ivo

robots.name: Gravity Simulator
robots.description: N-body sandbox — place stars, planets, moons. Click-drag to launch. Solar system, binary stars, chaos presets. Merging collisions.
robots.creator: serge-ivo

robots.name: Rocket Equation
robots.description: Tsiolkovsky visualized — adjust exhaust velocity and mass ratio. Saturn V, Falcon 9, Starship presets. See which missions you can reach.
robots.creator: serge-ivo

robots.name: Satellite Segmenter
robots.description: Segment satellite imagery by terrain type: water, vegetation, buildings, terrain. NDVI vegetation health analysis.
robots.creator: serge-ivo

robots.name: Kepler Laws
robots.description: All 3 laws interactive. Elliptical orbits, equal areas in equal times, T²/a³ relation.
robots.creator: serge-ivo

robots.name: Lagrange Points
robots.description: L1-L5 for Earth-Sun/Moon. Test stability. Place JWST at L2. CR3BP dynamics.
robots.creator: serge-ivo

robots.name: Re-entry Heating
robots.description: Atmospheric re-entry thermal sim. Heat shield ablation, plasma trail. Compare capsule shapes.
robots.creator: serge-ivo

robots.name: Gravity Assist
robots.description: Planetary slingshot maneuver. Speed gain visualization. Voyager grand tour path.
robots.creator: serge-ivo

robots.name: Orbital Rendezvous
robots.description: Two spacecraft docking. Phase-based burn sequence. Clohessy-Wiltshire relative motion.
robots.creator: serge-ivo

robots.name: Delta-V Map
robots.description: Interactive solar system delta-v graph. Click destination, see total cost from Earth. BFS routing.
robots.creator: serge-ivo

robots.name: Gravity Assist Planner
robots.description: Simulate gravity slingshots around planets. Pick departure, flyby, destination. See delta-v savings vs direct transfer.
robots.creator: serge-ivo

robots.name: Satellite Constellation
robots.description: Design Walker, sun-sync, polar constellations. 3D globe with orbiting satellites. Ground coverage and revisit times.
robots.creator: serge-ivo

robots.name: Reentry Simulator
robots.description: Heat shield physics: ablative vs radiative. Simulate g-forces, temperature, altitude. Capsule, shuttle, skip profiles.
robots.creator: serge-ivo

robots.name: Rocket Staging Optimizer
robots.description: Design multi-stage rockets. Pick engines, propellant, payload. Optimize stage ratios. Tsiolkovsky equation per stage.
robots.creator: serge-ivo
